'''Stefan Karol Estreicher''' is a [[Theoretical physics|theoretical physicist]], currently serving as Paul Whitfield Horn Distinguished [[Professor emeritus|Professor Emeritus]] at the Physics Department of [[Texas Tech University]] in [[Lubbock, Texas|Lubbock]], [[Texas]].

== Education ==
He received his PhD from the [[University of Zurich]] in 1982 and joined the faculty of Texas Tech University in 1986.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Estreicher |first=Stefan |date= |title=Stefan K. Estreicher {{!}} Faculty {{!}} People {{!}} Physics and Astronomy {{!}} TTU |url=https://www.depts.ttu.edu/phas/People/Faculty/bio_estreicher/bio_estreicher.php}}</ref>

== Academic Work ==
He was elected a [[List of American Physical Society Fellows|Fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1997 and a [[Fellow of the Institute of Physics|Fellow]] of the [[Institute of Physics|Institute of Physics (UK)]] in 2006. He won the [[Friedrich Bessel|Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel]] research award from the [[Alexander von Humboldt|Alexander von Humboldt Society]] in 2001. He served for 6 years as the Chair of the International Steering Committee of the ICDS conferences series and, also for 6 years, as the elected Spokesperson of the P.W. Horn Distinguished Professors at Texas Tech University. He has published over 200 scientific papers dealing with the electrical, optical, and magnetic properties of defects in [[semiconductor]]s. His studies of vibrational lifetimes<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1103/PhysRevLett.96.115504 | volume=96 | title=First-Principles Calculations of Vibrational Lifetimes and Decay Channels: Hydrogen-Related Modes in Si | year=2006 | journal=Physical Review Letters | article-number=115504 | last1 = West | first1 = D. | last2 = Estreicher | first2 = S. K. | issue=11 | pmid=16605840 | bibcode=2006PhRvL..96k5504W }}; {{cite journal | doi = 10.1103/PhysRevB.75.075206 | volume=75 | title=Isotope dependence of the vibrational lifetimes of light impurities in Si from first principles | year=2007 | journal=Physical Review B | article-number=075206 | last1 = West | first1 = D. | last2 = Estreicher | first2 = S. K. | issue=7 | bibcode=2007PhRvB..75g5206W }}</ref> revealed the concept of [[Phonon|phonon trapping]] which provides a natural explanation for why and how defects reduce heat flow.<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1038/srep32150 | volume=6 | title=Temperature dependence of phonon-defect interactions: phonon scattering vs. phonon trapping | journal=Scientific Reports | article-number=32150 | last1 = Bebek | first1 = M. B. | last2 = Stanley | first2 = C. M. | last3 = Gibbons | first3 = T. M. | last4 = Estreicher | first4 = S. K.| date=2016 | doi-access = free | pmid=27535463 | pmc=4989232 | bibcode=2016NatSR...632150B }}</ref> He was the first to calculate from first-principles the [[Kapitza resistance]] and its temperature dependence at a semiconductor interface.<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1002/pssa.201800428 | volume=216 | title=Phonon Dynamics at an Oxide Layer in Silicon: Heat Flow and Kapitza Resistance | year=2019 | journal=Physica Status Solidi A | article-number=1800428 | last1 = Stanley | first1 = Christopher M. | last2 = Estreicher | first2 = Stefan K. | issue=10 | bibcode=2019PSSAR.21600428S }}</ref> He also published several articles on the [[history of wine]] and [[viticulture]].<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Estreicher | first1 = S.K. | year = 2013 | title = A brief history of wine in Spain | url = | journal = European Review | volume = 21 | issue = 2| pages = 209–239 | doi = 10.1017/S1062798712000373 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Estreicher | first1 = S.K. | year = 2014 | title = A brief history of wine in South Africa | url = | journal = European Review | volume = 22 | issue = 3| pages = 504–537 | doi = 10.1017/S1062798714000301 }}</ref><ref>S.K. Estreicher ''Wine'', in "The Encyclopedia of Ancient History" (Wiley Blackwell 2015, updated 2018); ''France and wine: a brief history'' (preprint). These articles are available in pdf at https://www.depts.ttu.edu/phas/People/Faculty/bio_estreicher/bio_estreicher.php</ref>

== Family ==
He is the son of Zygmunt Estreicher (professor of musicology), grandson of [[Tadeusz Estreicher]] (professor of chemistry and historian), great-grandson of [[Karol Estreicher (senior)|Karol Estreicher senior]] (author of ''Bibliografia Polska''), nephew of [[Karol Estreicher (junior)|Karol Estreicher junior]], and grand-nephew of [[Stanisław Estreicher]].
